material_findings.title: ETHOnline 2026 now exposes an exact submission deadline, AI-use rules, and detailed sponsor tracks
material_findings.summary: ETHGlobal now states that ETHOnline 2026 projects are due September 13, 2026 at 12:00 PM EDT, require a 2-4 minute demo, and may select up to three partner prizes. AI tools are generally allowed with explicit attribution, but must assist rather than create the entire project, and AI text-to-speech voiceover is prohibited. The prize page displays ten sponsor pools totaling $77,000 in headline amounts; detailed tracks are currently visible for The Graph, Hedera, Arc, World, 1inch, ENS, and Uniswap. The Graph's $5,000 AI-tooling Continuity track explicitly permits extending an existing open-source repository and judges only substantive work added during the event, making it particularly relevant to this repository's build/tooling model.
material_findings.recommended_action: After the canonical replay chain reaches this observation, verify participant application/acceptance status and any stake/refund requirement, then evaluate a structured ETHOnline build case. If eligible, prefer a bounded continuity-track feature with clear pre-event provenance, commit history, live Graph data, a public README/SKILL.md, and human-directed AI use that complies with ETHGlobal's attribution and involvement rules.
